judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same production fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` by moving `await hooks.beforeSession(session)` inside the `try` block, and thoroughly updates both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` to document what `afterSession` can assume when `beforeSession` throws. By placing the new unit test in a dedicated `chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than inserting it into `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate avoids shifting line numbers in the existing test file and needing to update line-number links in unrelated specs (while properly updating the shifted line references in `chatOrchestrator.ts` caused by its added comment). The only minor gap compared to the reference test is that the candidate checks boolean/value flags (`caughtError` and `afterSessionRan`) rather than asserting the explicit execution order `['beforeSession', 'onError', 'afterSession']`.
